Name: HAN's portraits
Author: Hanyel
Description:
[color=#ff0000][b]IMPORTANT: Due to lack of time this mod is currently on-hold and so far I don't know if I'll ever continue it. [/b][/color]

Use these pics however you like - I'd be honored.
Just credit me if you want to be a cool person. 
Or don't, if you want to choose the villain path. 

[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/kM2FqRo.png[/img][/b]


I'm planning on making all of the SV portraits as well as:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url]﻿ 
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3226]Wizard Romancable Sprite[/url]﻿ by Chaekal-Rizum
[*]any other mod if you'd like me to do so and if time is generous
[/list]______________________

These portraits are hi-res. 
Using requires [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture mod[/url]﻿. 

HOW TO [s]FOR DUMMIES[/s]:
[list]
[*]Simply download both Portraiture mod and my portraits.
[*]Unpack Portraiture mod in your Mods folder.
[*]Unpack my drawings in Mods/Portraiture/Portraits folder. They need to be in separate folders.
[*]While chatting with any NPC press "P" until you find the portrait pack you want to use. [s]Which is mine? [/s]
[*]Congrats. You're officially a weeb now. 
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Basic NPC portraits - will be updated in the future.
